conversation.text: "Such things really aren't suitable for me." # Lina shakes off the Red Spider Lilies缠绕 around her. "Compared to things only seen in the underworld, I prefer natural flowers." The Spring Energy围绕 Lina changes again, from a bewitching red to green, a color filled with pure vitality. The Spring Energy tightly wraps Lina, and when it dissipates, Lina seems more mature. The microphone transforms into a conductor's baton. As Lina waves it, emerald vegetation begins to cover the land. We can hear the brass section of shouting trumpet flowers, pomegranate seeds flowing from cracked石榴敲打 on different mushrooms as percussion. At the center of this stage is Lina holding the baton. She approaches Yuyuko step by step as if strolling in a garden. This life-filled march envelops everything. "This is the most beautiful scenery in my eyes. I won't let you take them away. This is my willfulness!" As Lina forcefully swings down the baton, all plants rapidly蔓延 toward Yuyuko, wrapping her up and rendering her immobile. They take root and grow on Yuyuko, just as Saigyouji once榨取 flesh and blood, beginning to transform death into new life belonging to themselves.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Emerald vegetation covers the black jade floor tiles and pale buildings at an不可思议 speed. Huge trumpet flowers form the brass section, playing loud, life-filled fanfares; cracked pomegranates burst with plump seeds,敲打 on mushrooms of various sizes, producing crisp, rhythmic beats; vines摩擦 leaves,发出沙沙 string instrument低鸣. In this grand symphony played by life itself, Lina walks towards Yuyuko step by step as if strolling in her own kingdom. Her eyes are clear and resolute: "This is the most beautiful scenery in my eyes. I won't let you take them away. This is my willfulness!" The baton swings down heavily! All plants surge toward Yuyuko like receiving a final command, instantly吞没 her slender figure. Tough vines缠绕束缚 her limbs, huge petals try to包裹 her head, countless root-like细芽刺向 her gorgeous十二单衣, trying to穿透 that layer of death essence, just as the Saigyou Ayakashi榨取现世生机,反向地从 her汲取亡灵的存在, transforming it into their own蓬勃生长的养分! Even the坚固的结界护盾 cannot完全阻挡 this life洪流侵袭. Emerald plant roots顽强附着 on the rotating petal护盾,疯狂吮吸 its energy, causing the结界光芒剧烈闪烁,明灭不定,显然受到了相当的冲击与损耗. In this对抗 between极致生机 and绝对死亡, the entire Hakugyokurou剧烈震颤. "Pata, pata" Countless plants turn灰白. Yuyuko uses a怀念眼神抚摸还没有死去的植物. "Beautiful." Then gently lets go. All plants within the结界化作飞灰. This strike brings considerable波动 to the结界,以至于 Saigyou Ayakashi's petals减少了许多.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: She轻笑着,一边虚空一握. When the虚握的右手牵引着万千反魂蝶归巢, the air in Hakugyokurou骤然凝固. Those原本翩跹舞动的幽光蝶群发出无声的尖啸,朝着 her掌心疯狂坍缩,压缩,最终凝聚成一柄缠绕着暗紫蝶纹的苍白长枪. "Butterfly Sign 'Deadly Butterfly Spear'." The moment the long枪成型,不祥的死亡波纹如同水晕般扩散开来. Your hearts猛地一悸, as if your souls已被枪尖锁定. An instinctive, most primitive恐惧扼住了呼吸. The light around the枪身扭曲湮灭, space发出不堪重负的低鸣. The Sanzu River water化作流纹,为枪身做着最后的铺垫. As the long枪凝聚, Yuyuko手腕轻转, casually throws that spear凝聚着幽冥与死意. There is no呼啸的破空声, only a寂静的,贯穿生死的苍白流星. Where it passes, Lina's life-filled植物交响乐如同被抽离了色彩般瞬间枯萎凋零,连结界上的花瓣都为之黯淡. This spear points directly to the end of life. Danger. Will die. This strike, everyone will die.

conversation.text: As the spear tip逼近, Long'er's movements are also so slow. Too late. Impossible to make it. Will die. 50m. Long'er's movements seem frozen, having just taken one step. 10m. Everyone still hasn't脱离 from that shadow of death. Will die! 5m. Not an illusion. The shadow of death truly笼罩众人心头. Can't even act. Can't do it. The only thing possible is to await death's降临—— "Spirit Sign 'Fantasy Seal'!" At the final刹那, a清澈的少女音从身后传来. Then, a glowing gohei从身后掷来,狠狠地砸在了 the蝶枪之上. "Crack." The蝶枪传来皲裂声. The gohei狠狠地穿透了 the蝶枪, "Boom!"地砸在了地面上. Dust四散. Behind, a shrine maiden in strange red-white clothes flies towards you. "Cough, cough, I'm not late, am I?"
